description: Source code for the DittoClient class that manages interactions with the Eclipse Ditto API, including features like retrieving, updating, and patching things and features, with in-memory fallback support.

classes.name: DittoError
classes.description: Custom exception class for errors related to Ditto operations.

classes.name: DittoClient
classes.description: Client class for interacting with the Eclipse Ditto API, providing methods for CRUD operations on things and features, handling in-memory fallback, and managing specific features like alerts and KPIs.

methods.name: DittoClient get_ditto_client()
methods.description: Singleton accessor for the DittoClient instance.

methods.name: None __init__(self)
methods.description: Initializes the DittoClient with settings, client, headers, and in-memory store.

methods.name: Dict[str,str] _build_headers(self)
methods.description: Constructs HTTP headers with authorization based on settings.

methods.name: str _feature_url(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Builds URL for a specific feature of a thing.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_or_init_mem_thing(self, thing_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a thing in the in-memory store.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] _get_or_init_mem_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Retrieves or initializes a feature within a thing in the in-memory store.

methods.name: Optional[Dict[str,Any]] get_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str)
methods.description: Gets a feature of a Ditto thing, either from in-memory or via HTTP.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] put_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str, data: Dict[str, Any])
methods.description: Creates or replaces a feature for a Ditto thing, either in-memory or via HTTP.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] patch_feature(self, thing_id: str, feature_id: str, patch_ops: Any)
methods.description: Applies JSON patches to a feature, with fallback to read-modify-write if unsupported.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] ensure_alerts_feature(self, bng_thing_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures the 'alerts' feature exists with default structure.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append_alert(self, bng_thing_id: str, alert: str)
methods.description: Appends an alert string to the 'alerts' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] append_recommendation(self, bng_thing_id: str, rec: str)
methods.description: Appends a recommendation string to the 'alerts' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] get_bng_kpis(self, bng_thing_id: str)
methods.description: Reads BNG KPIs from the 'state' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] update_bng_kpis( self, bng_thing_id: str, cpu: Optional[int] = None, mem_pct: Optional[int] = None, active_sessions: Optional[int] = None, )
methods.description: Updates BNG KPIs in the 'state' feature.

methods.name: Dict[str,Any] set_subscriber_session( self, subscriber_thing_id: str, status: str, ip_address: str = "", last_allocated_at: Optional[str] = None )
methods.description: Updates subscriber session feature with status, IP, and timestamp.

methods.name: Dict[str,Dict[str,Any]] list_active_subscribers(self)
methods.description: Returns mapping of active subscriber features, either from in-memory or logs info if not supported.

methods.name: None ensure_thing_exists(self, thing_id: str)
methods.description: Ensures a thing exists in in-memory mode.
